The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is building a team dedicated to providing security coverage across a wide range of ecosystems and environments, working to make the world a better, safer place. We are hiring an Ubuntu Security Engineer to join an industry-leading security engineering team and help protect the open source community and Ubuntu users from emerging threats. We are looking for candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior.
As part of the Ubuntu Security Team, you will work with some of the best and brightest people in technology to monitor, triage, respond to, and document new and existing vulnerabilities in open source software. You will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify issues, prioritize them, and coordinate remediation.
This is an engineering-focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.
This role requires international travel at least twice a year, usually for one week. It also requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role
The role entails

  • Analyzing, fixing, and testing vulnerabilities in open source packages
  • Keeping track of vulnerabilities in the Ubuntu ecosystem as they are discovered, researched, and fixed, leveraging internal tools
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu community and upstream developers, as needed, to exchange or develop vulnerability patches and ensure that Ubuntu includes the most robust security features
  • Auditing source code for vulnerabilities
  • Building features and tools to help teams strengthen the security of their products and contribute to the overall security of Ubuntu
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and techniques for fixing them
  • You are familiar with coordinated disclosure practices
  • You are familiar with open source development tools and methodologies
  • You are skilled in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • You have excellent logic, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills
  • You can clearly and effectively communicate with the team and Ubuntu community members

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Data Scientist II / Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities (detailed)

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.

title: Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio
description:
Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio

O Instituto Vita Alere tem por visão uma sociedade mais aberta e atenta à saúde mental dos indivíduos, organizações e da própria sociedade, onde a promoção da saúde mental seja um objetivo contínuo, reduzindo preconceitos, criando consciência pública, falando abertamente, valorizando a vida, promovendo formas mais saudáveis de se relacionar e enfrentar os sofrimentos existenciais, facilitando a recuperação e tratamento.Pioneiro no Brasil em sua área, foi fundado em 2013 com a missão de promover a saúde mental do indivíduo, organizações, instituições e sociedade, com o foco na promoção de saúde mental, prevenção e posvenção do suicídio e autolesão, sendo referência na área através do desenvolvimento de projetos, tratamento especializado, pesquisa e atividades de educação, suporte e apoio, com inovação, dedicação, respeito e cuidado.Vita vem do latim, significa VIDA e Alere CUIDAR/NUTRIR, portanto trabalhamos para Cuidar e Nutrir a Vida das pessoas. Acreditamos que o suicídio pode ser prevenido e o luto deve ser acolhido.

Algumas das nossas atividades são:

  • Capacitar profissionais da saúde e educação para manejo em crise suicida e autolesão, criando multiplicadores em diversos setores.
  • Treinar profissionais da mídia e comunicação para lidarem de uma maneira cuidadosa e responsável sobre o tema.
  • Desenvolver projetos customizados em escolas, universidades, empresas e hospitais.
  • Minimizar o sofrimento das pessoas e oferecer suporte em situações de autolesão, comportamento suicida e luto por suicídio.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar métodos de promoção de saúde mental, valorização da vida e prevenção do suicídio, estando conectado com as pesquisas e estudos mais atuais do tema.

Somos o único Instituto Brasileiro associado ao IASP – International Association for Suicide Prevention e que presta serviços dessa natureza em São Paulo. Nossa equipe é formada por psicólogos e profissionais da área da saúde e educação, especialistas, mestres e doutores com destaque na área.

Especializações: prevencao do suicidio, luto por suicidio, suicidologia, psicologia, saúde mental, automutilação, posvenção, pesquisa, programas, palestras, cursos, treinamentos, atendimento, campanhas, educação sócio emocional, crise, orientação familiar e supervisão.

Funcionários da Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio

E aí? É só tristeza passageira… ou será que você está com depressão? Nem sempre é fácil diferenciar, mas reconhecer os sinais faz toda a diferença. Neste carrossel, você vai aprender a diferenciar esses dois estados e entender por que toda dor emocional deve sim ser levada a sério. Compartilhe com quem também precisa dessa informação. E lembre-se: existe ajuda profissional disponível. #InstitutoVitaAlere #PrevençãoDoSuicídio #Depressão #Tristeza #SaúdeMental

Cuidar da saúde mental é mais do que acolher: é saber para onde direcionar quem precisa de apoio. O Mapa Saúde Mental mostra caminhos reais para apoio em escolas, empresas e comunidade. No carrossel, você encontra canais essenciais de ajuda como CVV, CAPS e o Instituto Vita Alere, todos localizáveis com facilidade dentro do mapa. Isso faz total diferença nos momentos de urgência. Acesse e compartilhe este post com sua rede. #InstitutoVitaAlere #SetembroAmarelo #PrevençãoDoSuicídio #SaúdeMental #MapaSaúdeMental #CVV

Falar sobre suicídio exige boa vontade? Sim. Mas não só isso. Especialmente em espaços de trabalho e educação, é preciso preparo técnico, sensibilidade ética e compromisso com a continuidade. Uma comunicação mal conduzida pode reforçar estigmas, provocar silenciamentos ou, de tão superficial, simplesmente não gerar impacto algum. Pensando nisso, o Instituto Vita Alere reúne algumas boas práticas que fazem toda a diferença:

  • Capacitar e incentivar lideranças, gestores e educadores a buscar conhecimento de qualidade e desenvolver habilidades para acolher conversas difíceis.
  • Estruturar canais reais de escuta e suporte, que estejam disponíveis o ano todo, não apenas em setembro.
  • Utilizar dados confiáveis e referências científicas. Evitar o sensacionalismo e as frases de impacto que não levam a reflexão nem à ação.
  • Garantir que toda comunicação sobre saúde mental esteja inserida em uma política institucional mais ampla, com objetivos claros, recursos adequados e avaliação de impacto.

No Instituto Vita Alere, trabalhamos para que empresas e instituições construam ambientes mais seguros, responsáveis e atentos à saúde mental de suas equipes.

Setembro Amarelo é uma oportunidade importantíssima de conscientização e mobilização social. Mas para que ele faça a diferença de verdade, campanhas precisam ser cuidadosas, seguras e responsáveis. E não apenas no discurso, viu? Aqui está um checklist essencial para instituições que querem se posicionar de forma ética e efetiva:

  1. Ir além de apenas ações simbólicas - Iluminar prédios ou postar frases prontas só faz sentido se acompanhado de informação qualificada e acesso a recursos de apoio.
  2. Garantir continuidade na prevenção - A empresa precisa promover planos de capacitação permanente, grupos de apoio ou protocolos institucionais.
  3. Caminhos de suporte claros - Os canais de suporte e encaminhamento para casos identificados devem ser bem definidos.
  4. Avaliar o impacto real - Medir mudanças na percepção, busca por ajuda e fortalecimento de redes de apoio, e não apenas curtidas ou presença.
  5. Formar pessoas para dar suporte - Priorizar escuta ativa e primeiros socorros emocionais, em vez de eventos pontuais e sem continuidade.
  6. Planejar ações com clareza e intenção - Definir objetivos específicos, públicos alvo, linguagem acessível e evitar ações superficiais.
  7. Garantir a presença de especialistas - Envolver profissionais capacitados e experientes no tema.
  8. Sempre questionar as intenções - você está buscando marketing institucional ou transformação social?

No Instituto Vita Alere, apoiamos empresas e instituições a criarem ambientes emocionalmente seguros e preparados para lidar com a prevenção do suicídio de forma contínua. Acesse nosso site (vitaalere.com.br) e conheça os cursos e materiais de orientação que preparamos para transformar sua campanha em um compromisso real. #SetembroAmarelo #SaúdeMental #InstitutoVitaAlere #Prevenção

1º de setembro. O país começa a ficar amarelo. Hoje começa o Setembro Amarelo. E, como acontece todos os anos, vemos campanhas surgindo de todos os lados. Escolas, empresas, redes sociais, marcas. Nas próximas semanas, muita gente vai falar de saúde mental, de suicídio, de escuta, de empatia. Isso pode ser bom. Mas também pode ser superficial, confuso, até perigoso. No Vita Alere, nós trabalhamos com esse tema o ano inteiro. Acolhemos famílias em luto. Formamos profissionais. Desenvolvemos guias, pesquisas, encontros, redes. E todos os anos, quando setembro começa, sentimos uma mistura de coisas. É importante ver o tema ganhar visibilidade. Mas é preciso cuidado com o que se diz, com o que se promete, com a forma como se expõe o sofrimento alheio. Nem tudo que brilha é cuidado. Nem toda frase de impacto é prevenção. Setembro não é palco. É espaço de escuta, de compromisso, de continuidade. Falar sobre suicídio exige preparo, ética e responsabilidade. Exige reconhecer que não estamos falando de números, mas de histórias interrompidas, de famílias em pedaços, de silêncios que doem. E que a prevenção verdadeira não cabe em uma ação pontual, nem em uma publicação com hashtag. Setembro pode ser um convite. Mas não pode ser uma fachada. Se você trabalha com esse tema, pense no impacto do que compartilha. Se você vive com dor, não precisa se sentir obrigado a falar só porque é setembro. E se você quer ajudar, comece escutando. Pergunte antes de propor. Ouça antes de divulgar. Reconheça seus limites. Seguimos por aqui, atentos. Com acolhimento, com técnica, com presença. E com a coragem de lembrar que saúde mental não se resolve com cor de campanha, mas com trabalho sério, coletivo e contínuo. Estamos juntos, não só em setembro. #SaudeMental #PrevencaoDoSuicidio #SetembroAmarelo #VitaAlere

Como terapeuta, você já sabe: boa vontade não basta. Acolher famílias de adolescentes em sofrimento exige preparo, critério e ferramentas seguras.A autolesão na adolescência é um fenômeno cada vez mais presente nos contextos clínicos, escolares e comunitários, e raramente afeta apenas o jovem. Famílias inteiras acabam envolvidas nessa dor, muitas vezes entorpecidas por não saberem como intervir, acolher e fazer as lesões pararem.Pensando nisso, o Instituto Vita Alere oferece o curso Manejo da Família no Comportamento Autolesivo em Adolescentes, com a Prof. Dra. Bruna Mattos Machado. Uma formação essencial para quem atua com saúde mental e deseja se capacitar para orientar famílias de forma ética, técnica e sensível.O que você vai aprender:

  • Compreensão aprofundada da autolesão e sua relação com o suicídio
  • Fatores de risco e proteção no contexto familiar
  • Impactos da autolesão na dinâmica familiar

Invista no cuidado que realmente faz a diferença.#Autolesão #SaúdeMental #Psicoterapia #Psicoeducação #InstitutoVitaAlere #PrevençãoDoSuicídio #PsicologiaAdolescente #CuidadoEmocional

Cuidar da saúde mental no trabalho é muito mais do que uma prática possível: é dever de toda empresa que leva a sério a si mesma e as equipes que, todos os dias, a mantêm de pé. Para se ter uma ideia da dimensão dessa necessidade, é só conferir as pesquisas recentes sobre o assunto. Conforme dados do Ministério da Previdência Social divulgados pela Revista Veja, grande parte dos afastamentos em 2024 foi em razão de transtornos de ansiedade (141.414), seguidos por episódios depressivos (113.604) e por transtorno depressivo recorrente (52.627). Somente os afastamentos por ansiedade aumentaram mais de 400% na última década. E os casos de depressão quase dobraram. Ainda assim, quando abordamos esse tema, ele muitas vezes chega aos ouvidos como se fosse um assunto delicado a ponto de parecer intocável. Será que ainda precisamos de tanto receio em pleno 2025? Ao contrário do que se imagina, implementar medidas de cuidado emocional no ambiente corporativo não exige grandes investimentos, mas sim pequenas mudanças com alto impacto: ️ Incentivar pausas reais (sem culpa) ️ Treinar lideranças para escuta ativa ️ Normalizar conversas sobre saúde mental, sem tabu ou julgamento ️ Reavaliar aspectos da cultura organizacional que reforçam o silêncio ️ Criar espaços seguros para pedir ajuda sem medo de retaliação Cuidar da saúde mental no ambiente corporativo não é “mimar” equipes. É preservar o recurso mais valioso que uma empresa pode ter: pessoas inteiras, conectadas e capazes de sustentar resultados sem adoecer no processo.E aqui vai o ponto crucial: saúde mental não se resolve com uma ação no Setembro Amarelo e uma palestra por ano. Ela se constrói no cotidiano, com insistência e consistência.E aí, sua empresa está pronta para essa mudança, ou vai continuar apenas comprando balões amarelos?Fonte: #InstitutoVitaAlere #SaúdeMental #CulturaOrganizacional #AmbienteDeTrabalho #RHHumanizado #SegurançaPsicológica #GestãoDePessoas #BemEstarNoTrabalho

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment
description:
Overview

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM.
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform.
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization.
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform.
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats.
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation.
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement.
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise.
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR.
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO.
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments.
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows.
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence.
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules.
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus.
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex).

About Ruby Labs Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

Role We are creating a new D2C subscription product and are looking for a Managing Director to oversee day-to-day operations, drive execution, and build a world-class team.

Profit Share This role comes with a profit-sharing incentive and stock options that are quite generous, offering high earning potential. More details will be shared during the interview.

The team You will be building a strong team with high talent density who enjoy working in our fast-paced, 100% remote environment.

About You You are a dynamic and hands-on leader with extensive experience in the D2C Digital Products (preferably subscriptions). You excel at driving growth and innovation, with a deep understanding of engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategies. In this role, you will be at the forefront, leading all departments with a focus on executing strategic initiatives and optimizing performance across the board. Your proven ability to manage teams, deliver results under pressure, and deeply engage in the technical and operational aspects of the business makes you the ideal candidate to steer our company towards continued success.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the company's strategic growth by developing and executing initiatives that drive business expansion, optimize market positioning, and advance overall progress.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in executing complex strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment across engineering, product development, growth, marketing, and sales.
  • Drive revenue growth and profitability while optimizing operational expenses.
  • Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions that align with customer expectations and business goals.
  • Ensure that the product roadmap is aligned with business strategy and customer feedback.
  • Oversee marketing campaigns, ensuring they are data-driven, customer-centric, and aligned with product launches and sales strategies.
  • Utilize data analytics to refine and optimize growth strategies, ensuring sustainable revenue growth.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze key financial and operational metrics, such as revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and customer acquisition costs (CAC).
  • Evaluate customer lifetime value (LTV) and return on ad spend (ROAS) to optimize marketing efficiency and resource allocation.
  • Track onboarding conversion rates to identify areas for improvement in user experience and increase customer activation and analyze average revenue per user (ARPU) and user retention rates to inform product development and enhance long-term profitability.

What we offer

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom of working from anywhere, anytime, fostering a better work-life balance.
  • Stock options: We acknowledge the commitment required for the Managing Director role. Hence, we offer generous company stock options and revenue sharing to appreciate and reward your hard work.
  • Company-provided MacBook: We offer employees access to powerful MacBooks if needed, ensuring top-notch performance, energy efficiency, and seamless productivity.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
  • Technical Interview (90 minutes)
  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

description:
Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Director – Project Management – JLL

What this job involves

As Director of Project Management, you will be responsible for directing all project management activities and management of a team of 50+ project management professionals serving a Financial Services client. You will lead and develop the project management team in providing superior client service and project execution while partnering with other service line leaders and Center of Excellence teams in achieving account team goals. This role requires demonstrated ability to develop and manage a strong team of professionals focused on delivering value to the client while working within the process requirements of the client and JLL, playing a lead role in developing and executing an integrated strategy for your team to support success of the business unit\'s overall strategy.

What your day-to-day will look like

  • Direct all project management activities and manage a team of 50+ project management professionals
  • Lead and develop the project management team in providing superior client service and project execution
  • Partner with other service line leaders and Center of Excellence teams in achieving account team goals
  • Liaise across multiple internal and external teams including retail client, external design team, regional A&E partners, general contractors, and non-construction partners
  • Create a solution oriented environment whereby the regional team consistently seeks to identify leading edge project management practices
  • Provide regional perspective and input to the Center of Excellence team on enhanced service delivery components
  • Ensure team leads and project managers are fully aligned and exceed cascaded Client targets and the account business plan
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships between Service Line Leaders, Center of Excellence team, Team Leads, and Project Managers
  • Develop and deliver successful KPIs while effectively identifying and mitigating project risks

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s Degree from an accredited institution in Architecture, Engineering, or Construction Management
  • Minimum 12 years of managing large dynamic teams
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in managing design and construction of multiple projects across a broad geography
  • Experience in Building and Delivering Capital Planning
  • Strong understanding of real estate life cycle and proven ability to collaborate with transaction managers, facility managers, engineers, and planning teams
  • Strong working knowledge of accounting and financial reporting, budgeting, scheduling and process as they relate to corporate real estate
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and strong analytical skills
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and Microsoft Project scheduling software
  • Ability to effectively identify and mitigate project risks before they impact service delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving Financial Services clients
  • Leadership experience in retail construction and project management
  • Experience with Center of Excellence team coordination and strategy development
  • Knowledge of merchandising, technology, fixtures, furniture, and branding coordination
  • Advanced experience in KPI development and delivery
  • Experience establishing performance expectations and providing employee feedback

title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

Remote-first part-time freelance Brand Designer role at tl;dv. Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to a full-time role within 12 months based on impact. Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design. Compensation set based on agreed hours/work scope of part-time role (flexible).

We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

To learn more about the brand and culture, check out tl;dv Culture & Careers page and our Product Hunt launch. Direct access to founders and a fast-moving environment await.

We are looking for highly motivated team players to join our hungry squad.

Portions of text referencing people or media in this section have been preserved for context but will be presented in a clean format below.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of hands-on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; ready with references.
  • Bold yet coachable; able to defend strong creative while remaining collaborative.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego team player with crisp communication.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion skills (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SAas and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page.

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

Our clients’ success is our driving force. We are obsessed with creating exceptional experiences that empower global DTC brands to attract, convert, and retain customers at scale. From high-performing ad campaigns and creative iterations to AI-driven marketing solutions, we’re laser-focused on delivering strategies that surpass expectations and fuel sustained growth.

Visionary Thinking

At WKND, we don’t just look at where marketing stands today—we anticipate where it’s going tomorrow. We operate with a forward-thinking mindset, exploring how AI and emerging tech will reshape both acquisition and retention strategies over the next decade. Join us in laying the foundation for the future of eCommerce growth.

This is your chance to be part of a team where excellence is non-negotiable, and rewards are directly tied to performance. If you’re ready to tackle challenges, push boundaries, and define the future of data-driven marketing, WKND is where you belong. We don’t just aim to compete—we aim to lead.

The Power of Communication

At WKND, clear, proactive communication is the backbone of our high-performance culture. We believe in staying ahead of potential issues rather than reacting after problems arise. By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. This approach fosters accountability not just within individual departments but across the entire organization—everyone owns their deliverables while working cohesively toward common objectives.

As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. This involves active listening —genuinely hearing and understanding each stakeholder’s perspective, then offering thoughtful recommendations that drive both short-term impact and long-term success. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Ultimately, this culture of open dialogue and empathy elevates everyone’s contributions—enabling us to deliver world-class outcomes at speed.

Why Join WKND?

  • Build Innovative SaaS Solutions
    Contribute to developing scalable software designed for global eCommerce markets.
  • Solve Mission-Critical Challenges
    Address complex acquisition and business challenges using AI-powered tools that drive efficiency, engagement, and ROI.
  • Pace of Innovation
    Operate at the cutting edge of AI technology, where bold thinking and agility are the keys to success.
  • Performance-Based Rewards
    Benefit from a competitive compensation structure with stock options, directly aligning your growth with our company’s trajectory.
  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
    Collaborate with a team that values meaningful outcomes over mere effort and recognizes truly exceptional results.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .
Apply now to join our high-performance team, harness AI-driven insights, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital marketing. Together, we’ll redefine eCommerce growth and achieve exceptional results for our clients.

description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We seek an experienced and dynamic FX Sales Manager to drive business growth and manage relationships with key clients in the money remittance and financial services sectors. In this role, you will lead FX negotiations, collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions and ensure exceptional execution of cross-border payment transactions. You will leverage your expertise in FX markets to provide valuable insights to clients while consistently meeting sales targets and contributing to the organization’s overall success.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive negotiations with existing money remittance and financial services merchants, ensuring the achievement of sales targets while optimizing client value.
  • Build and maintain long-lasting relationships with clients by understanding their specific needs and delivering tailored FX solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Work closely with the internal Trader team to ensure alignment on market strategies, competitive pricing, and efficient execution of FX transactions.
  • Provide clients with actionable insights on FX market trends, movements, and forecasts, helping them stay informed and make sound decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of FX transactions, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and operational excellence.
  • Regularly conduct market analysis and research on industry trends and competitors to stay ahead of market developments and anticipate client needs.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What skills do I need?

  • Strong knowledge of local and international FX markets, including market dynamics, trading strategies, and regulatory environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets, with a track record of driving revenue growth and expanding business opportunities.
  • Exceptional business development, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with experience managing high-value client accounts.
  • In-depth understanding or experience with cross-border payment systems and their complexities, including risk management and cost optimization.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a logical problem-solving approach, helping identify opportunities and overcome challenges.
  • Highly self-motivated and goal-driven, with the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage , Linkedin , Instagram , and Youtube for more about dLocal!

title: Especialista Sênior Financeiro/Contábil - Simpaul Brazil
description:
Overview

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by over 280 million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Company Overview: Simpaul is 100% a Binance Company. The M&A was fully approved by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This strategic acquisition strengthens our presence in the Brazilian market and enhances our capabilities in the fintech sector. Read more:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance & Accounting Specialist!

This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, in alignment with both local regulatory requirements and Binance’s global standards. You will be the main point of contact for accounting, tax, and regulatory matters, supporting the business in a fast-paced and high-growth environment.

It is important that you bring expertise from BCB / financial regulated business (ie. Banks, Brokers, Funds or similar) in roles such as Financial Specialist, Accounting & Finance Specialist. Previous experiences in projects like new products, new business, new markets/segments is a differentiator.

Note: This role is 100% Remote, Work From Home based. Working Visa is not sponsored.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the month-end and year-end closing processes in accordance with local Brazilian regulations — particularly Receita Federal and Banco Central do Brasil — while ensuring compliance with Binance’s global finance policies.
  • Collaborate closely with the internal finance team to manage accounting and financial processes, ensuring accurate and timely accounting and tax closing.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the external accounting firm, monitoring deliverables, service quality, and outcomes.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Finance/Accounting in implementing upcoming cryptoasset regulations in Brazil, advising on impacts, requirements, and execution plans.
  • Monitor, analyze, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all regulatory reports to authorities such as the Banco Central do Brasil and Receita Federal do Brasil (e.g., CADOCs, statutory financial and tax filings).
  • Develop and maintain the company’s accounting, operational, and capital policies in line with current regulations, business needs, and Binance’s strategic directives (e.g., capital adequacy policies vs. transaction accounting).
  • Track and interpret changes in laws, resolutions, and regulatory instructions related to brokerage and payment activities, ensuring ongoing compliance and regulatory security.
  • Oversee and support all tax-related initiatives, including compliance with tax obligations, implementation of tax reform changes, and corporate reorganization or optimization projects.
  • Lead external audit activities, ensuring alignment with both regulatory requirements and Binance’s internal policies and practices.
  • Drive and support system implementation projects and the launch of new products, focusing on financial and accounting requirements.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the company on business process development, monitoring, and continuous improvement (e.g., internal audit, internal controls, policy updates).
  • Support Binance’s regional Finance and Treasury teams with inquiries, process adjustments, and compliance initiatives to align reporting and operations with corporate policies (e.g., consolidated results reporting).

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Controllership, Accounting Management, or Finance for banking, payment, or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge in accounting, finance, financial operations, cash management, tax, and payment processes.
  • Proven experience in financial products, financial back-office operations, and banking relationship management.
  • Previous exposure to core banking systems (preferred).

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

About The Role We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you\'ll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience. Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client\'s retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We\'re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

title: Manager - Route Acquisition
description:
Overview

At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact?

As the Manager - Out of Territory (OOT) Route Acquisition , you will be responsible for managing TDS associates and consultants who plan, coordinate, and supervise Colocation and Joint Use activities across multiple locations and states. The role requires close collaboration with representatives from field services, associate managers, consultants, Outside Plant engineers, COLO/ROW team members, third-party consultants, and construction/engineering contractors supporting both TDS CLEC and ILEC operations to ensure company needs are effectively met.

In this role you will oversee Colocation and Joint Use activities for TDS Telecom fiber networks, ensuring compliance with existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP standards. This position supervises colocation team members managing OOT and CLEC/ILEC projects throughout the entire TDS footprint.

Key responsibilities include monitoring costs, maintaining and generating reports, enforcing adherence to TDS standards and practices, developing workflows and protocols as needed, and tracking overall job progress to ensure construction projects are completed on time and within budget. You will actively drive TDS initiatives at both the team and organizational levels.

Additionally, you will set goals and expectations while fostering a positive work environment that supports coaching and mentoring team members to achieve those goals. In this role you will also proactively identify opportunities to enhance the skills of each team member, contributing to the ongoing development and elevated performance of the entire team.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the management of TDS associates and/or consultants who are responsible for planning, coordinating and supervising Out of Territory Route Acquisition activities in multiple locations and states. The person filling this position is expected to work closely with representatives from field services, associate managers, Outside Plant Engineers, OSPC team members, 3rd party consultants and construction/engineering contractors for TDS Out of Territory (OOT) operations to ensure that the needs of the company are being met.
  • The incumbent will be responsible for the OOT Route Acquisition activities of TDS Telecom fiber networks while conforming to existing RUS Outside Plant (OSP) guidelines and TDS OSP. The incumbent will be responsible for continually working with various permitting entities, contractors, and agencies when/where applicable. Negotiation, coordination, and cooperation skills to expedite permitting/workflow crucial to this role.
  • Verify all permitting documentation to gain approved access for OSP construction activities (R/W, Easements, PUE, etc) is accurate, complete and clear. The incumbent will seek to drive consistency and clarity of all protocols to expedite permit approval process.
  • Verify that all documentation required to complete projects successfully, including Bid Jobs, build orders, Job Start Agreements, RFP, legal agreements, permitting agreements and close-out documentation is complete.
  • Review all required reports from OOT Route Acquisition team and contractor invoicing for accuracy. Role will track and process PO’s, Check Requests, CLARITY, etc to drive accuracy for reporting internally to TDS finance department.
  • The incumbent will use strong OSP & Route acquisition background to assist in troubleshooting escalated issues when necessary to achieve expedited results with permitting entities or internal teams.
  • Provides human resource management and manpower apportionment necessary for completion of network projects. This includes managing in-house deployment staff as well as engaging and managing professional consultant engineers during peak periods. Focus is on personnel development through performance assessments, coaching, recognition, and process improvement.
  • Conduct periodic quality assurance inspection of OSP projects performed by Local Operations personnel.
  • Manage specific projects OSP projects directly if schedule permits
  • Design projects and prepare OSP workplans for construction or modification of network facilities if schedule permits. Including confirm and analyze OTDR trace results to verify contractor splicing quality.
  • Assist in the training of field personnel on standards, RUS and TDS practices, time reporting codes and report/form preparation.
  • Provide recommendations to management for improving standards and practices resulting in higher quality and lower cost projects.
  • Assist Network Operations staff in developing Capital Additions, Budget assumptions and long-range planning.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree (or higher) -OR- 4+ years professional work experience.
  • 5+ years\' experience in telephony or related fields.
  • 3+ years\' supervisory experience
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver\'s license.

Other Qualifications:

  • Excellent leadership, project management, customer relations and communications skills
  • Thorough Understanding of Telecommunications industry and principals.
  • Deep understanding of CLARITY/PM style programs and creating analytic reports.
  • Thorough understanding of financial tracking and budgetary reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Understanding of Colocation/Joint use process.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills.
  • Outlook, Excel and Office suite as well as GIS and ESRi.
  • Working knowledge of RUS construction practices and engineering standards.
  • Ability to work in a cooperative and courteous manner with diverse work groups.
  • Must be self-motivated and self-reliant.
  • May be required to regular travel on an "as-needed" basis.

Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today!

Benefits

We believe in taking care of our team, which is why we offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, financial well-being, and overall happiness. Join us and experience a work environment where your well-being is a top priority!

Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to:

In addition to these benefits, all associates will have the opportunity to participate in our Associate Resource Groups, which are designed to encourage community and facilitate professional development. To learn more, click here.

Who is TDS Telecom?

TDS Telecom provides high-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide.   • Utilize Google Sheets and other tools for sophisticated data manipulation and analysis
  • Simplify and present findings eloquently with a focus on connecting data to business outcomes
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance reporting capabilities and generate deeper insights
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem to enhance reporting capabilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics or digital marketing

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills for data manipulation and analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, or Google Data Studio
  • Understanding of statistical concepts like regression modeling, test/control analysis, etc.
  • Experience creating performance presentations and conveying data narratives
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Self-motivated and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Task Delivery Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed on or before delivery date
  • Task Accuracy Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed successfully on initial delivery (tasks not re-opened for inaccuracies or missed requirements)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Data Storytelling and Insight Generation: Transform raw data into meaningful narratives that highlight key performance indicators, trends, and actionable recommendations. Connect marketing metrics to business outcomes in a way that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Marketing Channel Expertise: Maintain deep understanding of digital marketing platforms, metrics, and campaign structures. Stay current with platform changes and be able to contextualize performance data within the broader marketing strategy.
  • Client Communication and Reporting Excellence: Develop clear, visually appealing reports and presentations that effectively communicate performance insights. Proactively identify opportunities, address client questions, and maintain regular communication regarding deliverables and timelines.
  • Continuous Improvement of Reporting Systems: Constantly seek ways to enhance reporting templates, dashboards, and analysis methodologies. Streamline reporting processes, improve visualization techniques, and incorporate new metrics to provide more comprehensive performance insights.

Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we help usher in the promise of AI.
